hub.title: Peer-to-peer webtools, armed with nostr.
hub.lead: Every tool here runs entirely in your browser and syncs over relays you choose. No sign-up needed, no server of ours, no tracking — and encryption happens before anything leaves your device.
hub.accountText: One account for every tool here. Your boards, files and chats follow you to every device you sign in on; without an account they stay on this device.
hub.accountSigned: Every tool here uses this account. Boards you made on this device before signing in are carried over.
hub.loadout.text: Grocery lists, to-dos, household inventory and markdown notes that sync between all your devices and whoever you share them with — rentry-style links, end-to-end encrypted. Works offline, and your devices put back whatever the relays forget.
hub.payload.text: Send files straight to another browser while you’re both online. Direct WebRTC when possible, encrypted through a relay otherwise, every 64 KB piece checked with SHA-256.
hub.pongjs.text: Retro two-player Pong between two browsers. Share a link or QR code or pick an open game, then play over a direct connection.
hub.enigmajs.text: Encrypted group chat rooms that vanish when the room closes. Share a code or QR and talk.
hub.devboard.text: A freelancer noticeboard: post availability or hiring notes signed with your own key, voted on by peers, gone when they expire.
hub.relaysText: Loadout syncs over these nostr relays; pick your own in its settings. Payload and pongjs still signal through public gun relays until they move to nostr too. Relays pass data along; they can’t read anything that was encrypted first.
hub.footer: Free software under the GPL — see the repository.
